lines.en: label chikaspring3:
scene chikarinmusic1
Another unexciting day winds down as two young creatures begin to contemplate finding their way back to their burrows.
lines.zh: 又一个平淡的日子即将结束，两只幼小的生灵开始琢磨着回到自己的洞穴。

lines.en: And while they’re silently thankful to have made it to sundown without their necks being torn open, it’s been unmistakably dull on the plains as of late. And they’re not sure how to feel.
lines.zh: 虽然它们暗自庆幸自己活到日落、脖子没被撕开，但最近这片平原明显沉闷得过分。而它们不确定该如何感受。

lines.en: Without the looming threat of predation, they’ve spent their time chewing on grass and picking bugs out of the dirt.
lines.zh: 没有捕食的威胁悬在头顶，它们就靠着嚼草、从土里挑虫子打发时间。

lines.en: They have so much space to run, but nothing to run from. So why does that make them feel incomplete?
lines.zh: 它们有大把空间可以奔跑，却没有什么需要逃离。那为什么这反而让它们觉得不完整？

lines.en: One creature stares outside and ponders whether or not the act of being chased is what excited her at all to begin with. And if these days are only boring now since her legs have begun to atrophy from lack of use.
lines.zh: 其中一只望着外面，思索着：究竟是不是「被追逐」这件事本身才让她兴奋？还是说如今这些日子之所以无聊，只是因为她的腿因久不奔跑而开始萎缩。

lines.en: The other creature’s thoughts are more complicated and conflicted, but we’ll get to them in a moment.
lines.zh: 另一只的思绪更复杂、更矛盾，不过我们待会儿再说。

lines.en: : Hah...
For now, we’ll zero in on Chika Chosokabe — a gyaru turned bad-girl who would not hesitate to take up the role of predator if the plains stay dull for far too long.
lines.zh: 现在，我们先聚焦 Chika Chosokabe——一个由辣妹蜕变成坏女孩的人，要是这片平原继续沉闷太久，她会毫不犹豫地担起捕食者的角色。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say she has anything against the other prey. It’s just that these seasons of unintended hibernation can cause things to get a little out of control every now and again.
lines.zh: 这倒不是说她对别的猎物有什么意见。只是这种非本意的蛰伏期，偶尔会让事情有点失控。

lines.en: As the eldest of the pack, the responsibility to reestablish control would likely fall on her. And she’s loved and feared enough that the others would be sure to follow.
lines.zh: 作为群体中最年长的一个，重建秩序的责任大概会落在她身上。而她既被爱戴又被畏惧，其他人一定会跟随。

lines.en: : Rin, question.
lines.zh: : Rin，问个问题。

lines.en: : How often do you think about jumping off a bridge?
lines.zh: : 你多久会想一次从桥上跳下去？

lines.en: But the leader of a pack must not be chosen based on age and status alone. Because, in this case, it’s the eldest who’s grown the most weary.
lines.zh: 但一个群体的领袖不能只凭年龄和地位来选。因为在这个例子里，最年长的那只反而最疲惫。

lines.en: You see, this creature spends the bulk of its time foraging for berries, just to split them with lesser creatures upon returning to the burrow.
lines.zh: 你看，这只生灵把大部分时间花在采集浆果上，只为回到洞穴后跟更弱小的生灵分食。

lines.en: She grows weaker and more tired by the day now that she does not need to remain alert at all times.
lines.zh: 由于不再需要时刻保持警觉，她一天比一天虚弱、疲惫。

lines.en: When her eyes close at night, she feels less inclined to keep them open to see what happens next.
lines.zh: 当她在夜里闭上眼睛，她越来越没有动力再睁开，去看看接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: And when the wind rushes into the hole in which she sleeps, she silently wishes for it to carry her away.
lines.zh: 而当风灌进她睡觉的洞穴时，她默默希望风能把自己带走。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic2
: Uhh...
But it won’t.
lines.zh: 但风不会。

lines.en: If she’s ever going to go anywhere, she needs to be the one to take the first step.
lines.zh: 如果她真要去某个地方，她必须自己迈出第一步。

lines.en: No wind, nor nature in any form will rescue her from the complete absence of motivation.
lines.zh: 没有任何风、任何形式的自然，能把她从彻底失去动力中拯救出来。

lines.en: And as she emerges from her hole and gazes at her reflection in the lake, it becomes clear that she must either drink from these waters for the rest of her life-
lines.zh: 当她从洞里钻出来，凝视湖中自己的倒影时，一切变得明晰——她要么余生都饮用这湖水——

lines.en: : Probably...not as much as you’d think?
lines.zh: : 大概……没你想的那么频繁吧？

lines.en: Or drown herself in them.
lines.zh: 要么就淹死在里面。

lines.en: : Fuck.
For this field is actually a farm.
lines.zh: 因为这片原野其实是一座农场。

lines.en: : Is that...something you’re thinking about doing?
lines.zh: : 那是……你在考虑要做的事吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic3
And the only ones who can move in and out are those big enough to hop the fence.
lines.zh: 而唯一能进出的，是那些大到能跳过栅栏的家伙。

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : But, like...not a big bridge. Maybe a small one. With some water below it that, like, wouldn’t definitely kill me if I fell in. But could. You know?
lines.zh: : 不过，那个……不是什么大桥。也许是小桥。下面有点水，就是那种掉下去不一定会死、但也可能死的。你懂吧？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic4
: Sorry. I’m just being dramatic. You don’t need to put me on suicide watch or anything.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是在夸张。你不用把我列入自杀观察名单什么的。

lines.en: : That’s good, because I have no idea how I would even do that. And I’m pretty sure people wouldn’t actually take me seriously when I say it’s “for a friend.”
lines.zh: : 那正好，因为我完全不知道该怎么做。而且我敢肯定，当我说这是「帮朋友问的」时，没人会当真。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic5
: Would you mind if I ranted about personal stuff for a few minutes? Because Yumi sucks at listening and it’s not like I can get my sister involved in any of my problems.
lines.zh: : 你介意我倒几分钟苦水吗？因为 Yumi 根本不会听，而且我也不可能把我妹牵扯进我的问题里。

lines.en: : You can rant as much as you want. I just have no idea how useful I’m going to be since I kind of suck at dealing with...almost everything, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 你想倒多少都行。我只是不知道自己能有多大用——现在想想，我处理……几乎所有事都很烂。

lines.en: : It’s about boys. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 是关于男生的事。可以吗？

lines.en: : Chika...I’m not allergic to boys. I’m bisexual. Why would that not be okay?
lines.zh: : Chika……我对男生又不过敏。我是双性恋。这有什么不行的？

lines.en: : Because romance can be an annoying, touchy subject and you’re still getting over a breakup.
lines.zh: : 因为恋爱是个烦人又敏感的话题，而且你还在走出分手的阴影。

lines.en: : With...a girl.
lines.zh: : 跟……一个女生。

lines.en: : Otoha is a girl, Chika. There was no penis there. I checked.
lines.zh: : Otoha 是女生啊，Chika。那儿没有鸡巴。我检查过了。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic6
: I meant “boys” as a concept! Not literal boys, Rin! Just pretend I said “romance” instead!
lines.zh: : 我说的「男生」是个概念！不是字面意义上的男生，Rin！你就当我说的是「恋爱」好了！

lines.en: : Fine, yeah. But again, dealing with that kind of stuff isn’t exactly my forte. Especially now that 100%% of my relationships have ended in complete and utter failure.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过再说一次，处理这种事真不是我的强项。尤其是现在，我 100%% 的恋情都以彻底失败告终。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic7
: No they haven’t. Otoha was never good enough for you anyway. And, if I were you, I’d see this as a good opportunity to get back out there and try again with someone who deserves your time.
lines.zh: : 才没有。Otoha 本来就配不上你。换作是我，我会把这当个好机会，重新出去找个配得上你时间的人再试一次。

lines.en: : But anyway...if you haven’t already guessed, this is about Sensei and me.
lines.zh: : 总之……你要是还没猜到的话，这事是关于 Sensei 和我的。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic8
: Whaaaaaaaaaaaat?
: You’re a bad actor.
lines.zh: : 你演技真差。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic9
: I’m a bad everything but that’s never stopped me before.
lines.zh: : 我什么都差，但这从来没拦住过我。

lines.en: : I like that. Your...perseverance is one of my favorite qualities about you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这点。你的……韧劲是我最喜欢你的一点。

lines.en: : Liar. If that were true, you’d have been immediately impressed by my confession and we would have made out on the beach and wouldn’t even be talking about Sensei right now.
lines.zh: : 骗子。要是真的，你早就被我的告白打动了，我们会在沙滩上接吻，现在根本不会在聊 Sensei。

lines.en: : Fair. But still, it’s cool that you can just...keep going the way you have been.
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过话说回来，你能就这样……一直走下去，挺酷的。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic10
: Sensei and I aren’t even broken up and I feel like my whole life is being torn apart. I can’t even imagine how I’d be if we ended things.
lines.zh: : 我和 Sensei 甚至都还没分手，我却感觉整个人生在被撕碎。我都不敢想象要是真分了，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Are you...actually thinking about ending things?
lines.zh: : 你……真的在考虑分手吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic11
: I’m not! But between the last couple months and just...the first few interactions he’s had since rejoining the world, it feels like he’s pushing me away.
lines.zh: : 我没有！但这两个月来，还有……他重新回到这个世界之后最初的几次接触，都让我觉得他在把我推开。

lines.en: : Like, he came over to babysit the other day and was totally gone by the time I came back. He didn’t even tell me he was leaving. I could have, like...called Yumi or something if I knew.
lines.zh: : 比如，前几天他过来帮忙带孩子，等我回来他人已经走了。他连走都没跟我说一声。我要是知道，大可以……叫 Yumi 来什么的。

lines.en: : Well...I mean...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是说……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: “Uhh” what? Give it to me straight. I can’t afford to beat around the bush at a time like this. My relationship is potentially on the line here.
lines.zh: : 「呃」什么？有话直说。这种时候我可没工夫绕弯子。我的感情搞不好就悬在这儿了。

lines.en: : I just mean...don’t you maybe think asking him to babysit in his current condition is kind of...not a great idea?
lines.zh: : 我只是说……你不觉得，在他现在这种状态下叫他来带孩子，有点……不太妥当吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic12
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...you remember what he said, right? About losing something?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你记得他说过的话吧？关于失去了某样东西？

lines.en: : Sensei’s kind of like...miserable right now. And he’s gone through patches like that in the past, sure. But this is way worse than I’ve ever seen. And I doubt I’d want to babysit in that condition.
lines.zh: : Sensei 现在有点……很痛苦。他以前当然也有过类似的阶段。但这次比我所见过的任何一次都严重。我怀疑自己要是在那种状态，也不想去带孩子。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic13
: Aaaaaaaaah fuck. Yup. I’m an idiot. I was so excited to have him back that I didn’t even think of that. It’s no wonder he just up and left. I would’ve done the same thing.
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊操。没错。我是白痴。我光顾着他回来了高兴，压根没想到这茬。难怪他转身就走。换我也会这么做。

lines.en: : Oh. Oh, okay. That was easy then. Is the rant over?
lines.zh: : 哦。哦，好吧。那这就好办了。倒完苦水了？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic14
: No. I don’t get very many opportunities to do this, so I need to make sure I get everything off my chest. But you’ll be allowed to rant back to me once I’m done. It’s only fair.
lines.zh: : 没。我很少有机会这样，所以得确保把心里话全倒出来。不过等我说完，你也可以对我倒。这样才公平。

lines.en: : Can I...postpone my half of the rant session? I have work today.
lines.zh: : 我能……推迟我那一半倾诉吗？我今天要上班。

lines.en: : I’ll allow it. Now, please brace yourself as I am about to talk about sex.
lines.zh: : 准了。那么，请做好心理准备，我要聊性了。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic15
: Ah!
: You dropped your guitar.
lines.zh: : 你把吉他掉地上了。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic16
: No I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我才没有。

lines.en: : I told you to brace yourself.
lines.zh: : 我说了让你做好准备。

lines.en: : Yeah, but there wasn’t a big enough gap between that and the sex word. You have to let me brace myself before you tell me to brace myself. Don’t you understand how my brain works by now?
lines.zh: : 是，可你说了「做好准备」和「性」这个字之间隔得太短了。你得先让我做好准备，再叫我做好准备。你到现在还不明白我脑子怎么转的吗？

lines.en: : I’ll do a better job in the future, I promise.
lines.zh: : 我以后会注意的，我保证。

lines.en: : Then...what do you want to say about...the designated topic of sexual intercourse? Which is a topic you have decided to discuss. Not me.
lines.zh: : 那么……你想对……「性交」这个指定话题说点什么？这可是你决定要聊的话题。不是我。

lines.en: : Should I or should I not press him for sex?
lines.zh: : 我该不该催他要性？

lines.en: : I’m...pretty sure it’s the boy who presses the girl for the mating press, right?
lines.zh: : 我……挺确定是男生对女生用「交配压制」才对吧？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic17
: Rin, no!
lines.zh: : Rin，不是！

lines.en: : No? Hold on. I have to Google this.
lines.zh: : 不是？等等。我得谷歌一下。

lines.en: : No, I meant like...press him in general!
lines.zh: : 不，我是说……就是催他！

lines.en: : Huh? Are you seriously that horny that you can’t wait until he doesn’t feel like he’s dying anymore to have him do you?
lines.zh: : 啊？你真就饥渴到等不及他不再觉得自己快死了，就要他来干你吗？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic18
: That’s not...the entire reason. It’s more like...
lines.zh: : 那不是……全部原因。更像是……

lines.en: : I know Sensei uses sex to make himself feel better rather than talking things out. But when I tried the other day, he didn’t want to.
lines.zh: : 我知道 Sensei 是靠性来让自己好受些，而不是把事情谈开。但我前几天试了试，他不愿意。

lines.en: : And I’m not sure if I should try again because I’m not sure if it was, like...just a bad time or if he doesn’t want to have sex at all for a little while.
lines.zh: : 而我不确定该不该再试一次，因为我不确定那是……只是时机不对，还是他短期内根本不想做爱。

lines.en: : And it’s fine either way, I just don’t know how to make him feel better and...
lines.zh: : 两种都行，我只是不知道该怎么让他好受一点，而且……

lines.en: : And yes, I am also very horny.
lines.zh: : 还有对，我也非常饥渴。

lines.en: : Well, as someone who has never had sex with Sensei, I do not think I can properly instruct you when it is and is not a good time to try and do that with, to, or on him.
lines.zh: : 嗯，作为一个从没跟 Sensei 做过爱的人，我觉得我没法正确指导你，什么时候适合跟他做、对他做、或者在他身上做。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic19
: Figures.
lines.zh: : 意料之中。

lines.en: if rincthree:
: I guess I should wait for a better time to ask about the threesome then.
lines.zh: : 那我看我该挑个更好的时机再问三人行的事。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic20
: A better time to ask about the what?
lines.zh: : 挑个更好的时机问什么？

lines.en: : Threesome. You, me, and Sensei.
lines.zh: : 三人行。你，我，还有 Sensei。

lines.en: : Like...going to the movies?
lines.zh: : 像是……去看电影？

lines.en: : Sure.
: Because for a second-
lines.zh: : 因为刚才有一瞬间——

lines.en: : And then having sex with each other.
lines.zh: : 然后互相做爱。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic21
: Ngh!
: You dropped your guitar again.
lines.zh: : 你又把吉他掉地上了。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic22
: You didn’t even tell me to brace myself that time! And what’s this about a three-
lines.zh: : 这次你连「做好准备」都没说！还有这个三人——

lines.en: : Shh. Keep your voice down.
lines.zh: : 嘘。小声点。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic23
: What is this about a threesome? Why me? Why now?
lines.zh: : 这个三人行是怎么回事？为什么是我？为什么是现在？

lines.en: : The short version is that I wanted to do something special for Sensei and that I told him I’d be open to a threesome with him and a girl of his choosing.
lines.zh: : 简单来说就是：我想为 Sensei 做点特别的事，就告诉他，我愿意跟他和他自己选的一个女孩玩三人行。

lines.en: : So who backed down and why am I the replacement for them?
lines.zh: : 所以是谁退出了，而我又为什么成了替补？

lines.en: : Rin. He chose you, dummy.
lines.zh: : Rin。他选的是你，笨蛋。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic24
: Me?! Why?
lines.zh: : 我？！为什么？

lines.en: : A bunch of reasons, probably. You two are close...you swing both ways...and you had a crush on me for a million years, so he probably wants to see the chemistry.
lines.zh: : 大概有很多原因。你们俩关系好……你双性恋……而且你暗恋了我一万年，所以他大概是想看看化学反应。

lines.en: : But I guess there’s no point in trying to arrange this now if I have no idea when he’ll even want to do it again.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，既然我不知道他什么时候才会再想做这事，现在安排也没什么意义。

lines.en: : And you...you’re okay with this? With me?
lines.zh: : 而你……你不介意？跟我？

lines.en: : Hm? Of course. Why wouldn’t I be? I’d have probably chosen you as well if he let me pick.
lines.zh: : 嗯？当然。我为什么会介意？要是他让我选，我大概也会选你。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic25
: Oh my God. I should have known this was a dream the moment you said the word “sex.”
lines.zh: : 我的天。你一说出「性」这个字，我就该知道这是在梦里。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic26
: You realize you’re going to make me blush too if you keep blushing like that, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你再这么脸红下去，我也要跟着脸红了吧？

lines.en: : You’re already blushing! And this is your fault! I just wanted to play guitar!
lines.zh: : 你已经脸红了！而且这都是你的错！我本来只想弹吉他的！

lines.en: : Okay but, in my defense, it’s been over two months since I’ve done anything and I can’t even walk down the produce aisle without getting hot at this point.
lines.zh: : 好吧，但替我自己说一句——我已经两个多月没做过了，现在连走过农产品货架都会发烫。

lines.en: : What kind of fetish is that?!
lines.zh: : 那算什么癖好啊？！

lines.en: : Are you in or out? Whenever things start moving again, I mean. Just give me a yes or no answer. We don’t need to spend any more time on it than that.
lines.zh: : 你到底参不参加？我是说等事情重新有进展的时候。给我一个是或不是就行。我们不用在这上面耗更多时间。

lines.en: : Chika...
lines.zh: : Chika……

lines.en: : I need to...think about this...
lines.zh: : 我需要……考虑一下……

lines.en: : There is...literally no denying that this is a dream come true in many ways, but...I...
lines.zh: : 从很多方面来说，这确实……简直就是梦想成真，我无法否认，但我……

lines.en: : It’s fine. Just...we can drop it for now and get back to it later. You’re still freshly broken-up with, so I can see why you’d want to maybe-
lines.zh: : 没事。我们……可以先放下，以后再说。你才刚分手，所以我理解你也许想——

lines.en: : Mutually freshly-broken up with.
lines.zh: : 是双方共同刚分的手。

lines.en: : Yeah. That.
lines.zh: : 嗯。对。

lines.en: : Anyway, we can talk about it later.
lines.zh: : 总之，这个以后再说。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic27
: For now, I guess I just need to...figure out the next steps when it comes to handling this whole relationship thing.
lines.zh: : 现在，我想我只需要……想清楚接下来该怎么处理这整段关系。

lines.en: : We’ve got into little fights and stuff before. And all of them were because of things I was doing wrong, so...
lines.zh: : 我们之前也闹过小矛盾什么的。而每次都是因为我做错了事，所以……

lines.en: : I’m sure this is all going to blow over and that I’ll...have more mistakes to learn from when it does.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这一切都会过去，而等它过去，我……又会有更多错误可以吸取教训。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic28
: Are you sure you should be looking at them as mistakes at all, though? Because you’re like...the one person I can’t imagine tripping up when it comes to relationship stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过你确定该把它们看成错误吗？因为你……是我唯一无法想象会在感情上栽跟头的人。

lines.en: : You’re nothing like me when it comes to that. Your head’s so firmly on your shoulders at all times that I often think you’re just a really hot, fleshy mannequin.
lines.zh: : 这方面你跟我完全不同。你的脑袋永远稳稳地长在肩膀上，以至于我常觉得你只是个非常火辣、有血有肉的人体模特。

lines.en: : I think making little mistakes is pretty unavoidable when it comes to relationships. I’m just not really sure how to handle or...even accept that I might not be able to help this time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在感情里犯点小错是很难避免的。我只是不太确定该怎么处理，甚至……怎么接受这次我可能帮不上忙。

lines.en: : And that sucks. It really sucks. Like...you know things are bad when Ami is able to help and I’m not.
lines.zh: : 而这很糟。真的很糟。就像……当 Ami 都能帮上忙而我不能时，你就知道情况有多糟了。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic29
: Hey. Unrelated note — just out of curiosity, if I ever needed help burying a body, could I rely on you?
lines.zh: : 嘿。说个不相干的——纯粹好奇，要是哪天我需要人帮忙埋尸体，我能指望你吗？

lines.en: : I’m...not going to bat for Ami when it comes to all that weird shit she said in class the other day. But I don’t think murdering her is the answer.
lines.zh: : 我……不会为 Ami 那天在课上说的那些怪话辩护。但我觉得杀了她不是解决办法。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic30
: Murder? Ami? That thought never even occurred to me.
lines.zh: : 谋杀？Ami？我压根没往那方面想过。

lines.en: : She needs help, Chika. Like...serious help.
lines.zh: : 她需要帮助，Chika。那种……很严重的帮助。

lines.en: : But she’s so stable and normal.
lines.zh: : 可她看起来那么稳重又正常。

lines.en: : I get that she rubbed you the wrong way. She rubbed all of us the wrong way. But I think some of us might be taking things a little too hard on her right now.
lines.zh: : 我明白她让你不舒服。她让我们所有人都不舒服。但我觉得我们有些人现在对她有点太苛刻了。

lines.en: : Especially since she’s not even here to defend herself.
lines.zh: : 尤其是她连为自己辩解都不在这儿。

lines.en: : To be fair, I’m not really sure there’s anything she could say that would help her defend herself. Not from me, at least. Especially not when she’s going to try to blackmail me with my own nudes.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我真不确定她能说出什么来为自己辩护。至少对我没用。尤其是当她打算拿我自己的裸照来勒索我的时候。

lines.en: : Yeah...I had a feeling that’s what she showed you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我就觉得她给你看的是那个。

lines.en: : Whatever. At least now she knows I’m fucking her uncle and I don’t have to dance around it anymore. If she wants to use that against me, whatever. I know she’s not going to expose Sensei, though.
lines.zh: : 随便吧。至少现在她知道我在跟她叔叔上床，我也不用再绕来绕去了。她想拿这个对付我，随便。不过我知道她不会把 Sensei 抖出来。

lines.en: : I thought more about it and she’d gain literally nothing from him being arrested, so at least I’ve got peace of mind in knowing he’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 我想得更清楚了——他被抓对她一点好处都没有，所以至少我安心了，知道他会没事。

lines.en: : You’re thinking too much about him and not enough about yourself...
lines.zh: : 你想他想得太多了，想自己想得太少了……

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic31
: It’s like...
lines.zh: : 就像是……

lines.en: : With Otoha and me...it’s pretty clear in hindsight that I was asking for way more than what she was willing to give. And I love Sensei...but I don’t want you to fall into that same trap with him.
lines.zh: : 拿我和 Otoha 来说……现在回头看很清楚，我要求的远比她愿意给的要多。而我爱 Sensei……但我不希望你跟他也掉进同样的陷阱。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic32
: Hm.
: I guess that’s how it would look to you.
lines.zh: : 我想在你看来就是那样吧。

lines.en: : We’ve kept our situation pretty confidential because of the impact it could have on him, so it’s probably tough to see how much he really loves me from the outside.
lines.zh: : 我们一直对这段关系保密，因为曝光会影响到他，所以从外面大概很难看出他有多爱我。

lines.en: : He’s nothing like Otoha, though. She was straight up evil and I still can’t believe the way she treated you.
lines.zh: : 不过他跟 Otoha 完全不同。她就是纯粹的恶毒，我到现在都不敢相信她那样对你。

lines.en: : You’re making her out to be way worse than she actually was, Chika. She just...
lines.zh: : 你把她说得比实际上坏多了，Chika。她只是……

lines.en: : She didn’t love me.
lines.zh: : 她不爱我。

lines.en: : But she said she did. And that’s unforgivable.
lines.zh: : 可她说过她爱。而这是不可原谅的。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic33
: Okay! Rant over. I feel way better now.
lines.zh: : 好！倒完了。我现在好受多了。

lines.en: : Did it accomplish anything? No. Am I still just as lost and screwed as I was ten minutes ago? Yes!
lines.zh: : 有解决什么吗？没有。我是不是还跟十分钟前一样迷茫、一团糟？是的！

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic34
: But at least I got to talk to somebody who will actually listen.
lines.zh: : 但至少我跟一个真正愿意听的人说了。

lines.en: : Yumi listens too. She’s just scary.
lines.zh: : Yumi 也会听啊。她只是很吓人。

lines.en: : You only think she’s scary because you don’t know her.
lines.zh: : 你觉得她吓人，只是因为你不了解她。

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic35
: And because I watched her beat Nodoka halfway to death. Even if that’s something we’ve all kind of wanted to do at times.
lines.zh: : 还因为我亲眼看见她把 Nodoka 打得半死。虽然那事我们大家多少都想干过。

lines.en: : Fair enough. What’s the plan now, though? Still going to work? Or would you rather come over and see my cool, new apartment?
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过现在什么打算？还去上班？还是想来我家看看我那超酷的新公寓？

lines.en: scene chikarinmusic36
: Definitely the apartment. But I’m trying to get promoted, so I don’t think skipping work is a thing I should be doing right now.
lines.zh: : 当然想去公寓。但我在争取升职，所以我觉得现在不该翘班。

lines.en: : Offer’s still there whenever you’re free. And if you bring a peanut-free snack, you can immediately gain the undying affection of my little sister who will one day be the prime minister of Japan.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候有空都可以来。而且只要你带一份无花生零食，就能立刻赢得我妹永恒的好感——她将来可是要当日本首相的。

lines.en: : It’ll be good to have her on your side for when the next space war starts.
lines.zh: : 等下一次太空战争爆发，让她站在你这边会很有用。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll keep that in mind for my next day off. But for now, I must get dressed!
lines.zh: : 我下次休假会记住的。但现在，我得去换衣服了！

lines.en: : Need any help?
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Need? No. Want? Yes. Will accept? No again. Bye!
lines.zh: : 需要？不需要。想要？想。会接受？还是不会。拜拜！

lines.en: : Hahah! Later, Rin.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！回见，Rin。

lines.en: : Thanks for listening to me complain! I’ll be sure to keep you updated on my sex life and the status of my relationship with someone I shall not name within these walls!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你听我抱怨！我一定会随时向你更新我的性生活，还有我跟某位在这屋子里不能提名字的人的感情状况！

lines.en: : You don’t have to do that, but thank you!
lines.zh: : 你不用这样的，不过谢谢你！

lines.en: And so our segment focusing on Chika Chosokabe comes to an end-
lines.zh: 于是，我们聚焦 Chika Chosokabe 的这一段到此结束——
